notes.title: Update v0.4.1.3
notes.notes:
Dialogue and Menu UI fixes
 Prevented Knockback from carrying across rooms
 Soul boost in Library maze is no longer infinite
 Load menu shows save file information like playtime and save location
 Some puzzles have clearer mechanics

notes.title: patch v0.4.1.2
notes.notes:
- Fixed locked doors showing inaccurate unlock requierments
- Gamepad and Keyboard controls listed separately in menu

notes.title: v0.4.1.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed a file name mismatch in the Steam launch options vs. which files were actually installed. If you do not see an option to Update the game in your library, try right-clicking the title in your games list, selecting Properties..., Installed Files, and verifying the integrity of the files. This should manually install the correct file names.

notes.title: patch 0.4.1.1
notes.notes:
Linux support should now be available!

Some minor (but important!) changes this update. If you encounter any issues, especially with the following features, please report them using the Submit Feedback button on the game's title screen.


QoL Changes in Levels
Improved GUI & Tooltips
Menu QoL Improvements
Hotkey for Flourish Swap
Better Controller Support
